svg.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: DEPLOYS PER PLANT — ONE PER SITE
One EdgeConnect deploys at each plant. One EREMOS V2 tenant aggregates many sites.
Standard MQTT and OPC UA make the integration interoperable with whatever else you run.
